text: I was born ’ere so I know another way in.[VAR 0114(000D)]

If you wanna get into the town, how ’bout I
show you the way?\c
But...you’re my rival. So you’ll have to beat
me in a battle first, got it?[VAR 0114(000D)]
Oh, did I misjudge you...?\c\nAhhh, I get it. You need to get ready!\nGo on, then! I’ll wait here until you’re ready.[VAR 0114(000D)]

You’ve had a pretty good win streak in the Gym
Challenge, just like me! I respect you as my rival
and all that, but I got too much at stake to go
around losin’ now![VAR 0114(000D)]

My partner Morpeko has been interested in
you and your strength, and I think I get it now.\c
But I’ve got everyone in Spikemuth
supportin’ me![VAR 0114(000D)]

I’m definitely gonna get all eight Gym Badges
just so I can have a rematch with you.
Don’cha forget it!\c
I’ll get my revenge in the Champion Cup![VAR 0114(000D)]
Anyway, I promised I’d show you a way in, so\nfollow me![VAR 0114(000D)]
